overall_quality.evidence: Eventual consistency is a property of distributed systems where data is replicated across multiple nodes. It ensures that all nodes will eventually agree on the latest state of the data, but it doesn't guarantee that all nodes will be in sync at any given moment. This approach is useful in scenarios where immediate consistency is not critical, and the system can tolerate some delay in data synchronization.
